PLAY · THE FOUR SEASONS

Penguin’s Seasons Discovery

The seasons change the trees! Tap a season, then tap the tree picture that matches it.

Tap a season, then tap the tree that matches.

A year of trees!

Spring buds, summer green, autumn gold, winter bare — the whole year in four pictures.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Season matching turns a year into a story your child can retell. Ask which season comes AFTER each one, and what they wear in the snowy picture.

Prefer paper? The Penguin’s Seasons Discovery worksheet prints the same experiment with room to think and draw — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
